Technique samples provide evidence before or alongside the final garment. They show how seams, finishes or hems were practised and refined.
Each construction step should include a quality check. Checking alignment and finish early prevents faults carrying forward.

Equipment is used to make the item; resources are consumed in making it. The distinction supports planning and accurate documentation.
A costing table records item, quantity, unit cost and total. The columns make the calculation traceable.
Use real receipts, labels or teacher-issued figures. Evidence-based costs can be checked and updated.
